impact.text: ETH sent to Core is stuck forever.

precondition_sources.text: Victim submits a swap with sqrtRatioLimit set near the current price for slippage protection (e.g., tickToSqrtRatio(0-500)).
Victim's swap transaction carries a nonzero msg.value (10 ether).
The pool is initialized at tick 0 with liquidity.

intent_sources.text: When a swap is executed with msg.value > 0, the sent ETH must be accounted for in the pair debt system via _updatePairDebtWithNative() so it is not left unaccounted in Core.
A swap that would be a no-op (sqrtRatio == sqrtRatioLimit) while msg.value > 0 must revert rather than silently accept the ETH.
ETH sent to Core must remain recoverable through proper debt accounting and withdraw(), not become permanently stuck.
